page_title: GRA 0-1 VAL | Granada CF v Valencia 04/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Alejandro Hernandez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Valencia keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The statistic for corner kicks – 5:4.
86' Today's match ends for Hugo Duro who will be replaced by Alberto Mari (Valencia).
86' Granada CF have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
83' Some neat passing and movement from Granada CF as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
79' Jose Ramon Sandoval has decided to substitute Myrto Uzuni and he is replaced by Matias Arezo (Granada CF).
79' Substitution. Sergio Ruiz leaves the pitch and is replaced by Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF).

77' 0 - 1 Goal! Andre Almeida (Valencia) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Augusto Batalla is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 0:1.
77' Pepelu (Valencia) will take a corner kick.
73' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar!
72' The total number of attempts is 8:3.
70' Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
69' Here is a change. Fran Perez is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Peter Gonzalez (Valencia).
69' One of the players from Granada CF times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
67' Granada CF take a short corner kick.
65' Substitution. Bruno Mendez walks off the pitch and Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) comes on as a substitute.
63' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) for his blatant foul.
62' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 56:44.
59' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
57' Here comes a substitution. Theodor Corbeanu is given a rest as he is replaced by Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF).
57' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) replaces Dimitri Foulquier.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andre Almeida (Valencia) comes onto the pitch so that Sergi Canos can be given a rest.
56' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Diego Lopez (Valencia), but the defence gets it clear.
55' Some great controlled play and passing from Granada CF. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
53' Thierry Correia (Valencia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
52' Thierry Correia (Valencia) picks up an injury.
50' Valencia take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
49' Sergi Canos (Valencia) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Augusto Batalla, who smothers the ball.
48' Granada CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
43' The ball falls kindly for Sergi Canos (Valencia) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post.

42' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off an easy save.
40' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 12:4.
38' The game is interrupted. Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
37' Valencia are seeing far more of the ball now.
35' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

32' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alejandro Hernandez blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
30' 6:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
28' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) takes the corner which is cleared.

27' Great save! Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Giorgi Mamardashvili. Granada CF earn a corner.
27' A pass from Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) is intercepted by Giorgi Mamardashvili and the move breaks down.
24' PENALTY APPEAL after Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
24' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
23' What a great touch by Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
23' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

22' Fran Perez (Valencia) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Valencia force a corner. They send men into the box.
20' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
19' Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pepelu (Valencia). Granada CF win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
18' Crossbar! Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 34:66.
14' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
13' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
11' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
10' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
9' Fran Perez (Valencia) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner.
8' The Valencia players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
7' Sergi Canos (Valencia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
6' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle. Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) commits a foul after dangerous play.
4' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) heads on.
3' Sergi Canos (Valencia) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Augusto Batalla comes off the line to clear the ball away.
2' Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
1' The first half has just begun.
Granada CF will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alejandro Hernandez.
